verified_facts.text: W Fort Lauderdale is set along Fort Lauderdale's A1A beachfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: W Fort Lauderdale is set along Fort Lauderdale’s A1A, one of South Florida’s most iconic and swimmable beaches.

verified_facts.text: A beach of soft golden sand and gentle surf is just steps from the rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just steps from your room, you’ll find a beach of soft golden sand and gentle surf to bask in.

verified_facts.text: WET Deck is a rooftop pool deck five floors above the Atlantic with cocktails, bites and cabana lounging.
verified_facts.excerpt: Five floors above the Atlantic, WET Deck is your all-day sun scene at W Fort Lauderdale—a bold rooftop escape for cocktails, bites, cabana lounging, and ocean-view revelry.

verified_facts.text: On the rooftop, guests can book a private cabana or bungalow with shade, service and a front-row view of the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: For a more exclusive way to experience the rooftop, settle into a private cabana or bungalow complete with shade, service, and a front-row view of the pool.

verified_facts.text: In Tower I, the Oceanfront Suites have expansive balconies and Atlantic Ocean views, steps from the sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: In Tower I, our Oceanfront Suites place you steps from the sand with expansive balconies, breathtaking Atlantic Ocean views, and the vibrant energy of a luxury beachfront resort.

verified_facts.text: In Tower II, the Residential Suites have full kitchens, separate living areas and views of the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic.
verified_facts.excerpt: In Tower II, our Residential Suites offer elevated space and comfort with full kitchens, separate living areas, and stunning views of both the Intracoastal Waterway

verified_facts.text: AWAY Spa is on the fourth floor of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the fourth floor of our beachfront hotel, AWAY Spa is your sanctuary for full-body rejuvenation and beauty transformation.

verified_facts.excerpt: James Beard Award Winner Stephen Starr brings a unique interpretation of classic steakhouse dining to our Fort Lauderdale restaurant near the beach. Sample prime dry-aged beef, delectable sides, and an innovative cocktail menu.

verified_facts.text: The Living Room is a restaurant and bar overlooking the ocean, serving breakfast, cocktails and dinner bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Living Room is a Fort Lauderdale restaurant and bar where guests come to enjoy breakfast bites over looking the ocean, as well as mix, mingle, and sip on hand-crafted cocktails and delectable dinner bites.
